trans-unit.source: The hero crosses time once more in pursuit of Dhaos, setting off on another perilous journey.
trans-unit.target: The hero crosses time once more in pursuit of Dhaos, setting off on another perilous journey.

trans-unit.source: But this time is different. Now, his friend of peerless spirit is by his side.
trans-unit.target: But this time is different. Now, his friend of peerless spirit is by his side.

trans-unit.source: Their might combined, no enemy can stand before them. Yes, not even Dhao--
trans-unit.target: Their might combined, no enemy can stand before them. Yes, not even Dhao--

trans-unit.source: Uhh... Would you quit the self-indulgent narrative?
